segs.en: There are six people in my family: Grandma, Dad, Mum, my older brother, me and my little sister.
My sister is five, and there's nothing she loves more than sleeping.
When the weather is nice, we often go out together.

zh: 我家有六口人：奶奶、爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、我和妹妹。妹妹五岁，她最爱睡觉。天气好的时候，我们常常一起出去玩儿。

segs.en: Monday to Friday
On Monday morning it started to rain. The rain was heavy, and the wind was strong.
Dad drove us to school.
In the evening, Dad cooked at home. “It's raining,” he said. “Let's eat in tonight.”

zh: 星期一早上，下雨了。雨很大，风也很大。爸爸开车送我们去学校。晚上，爸爸在家做菜。他说：“下雨了，我们在家吃饭吧。”

segs.en: On Tuesday it was still raining. It turned cold.
When Mum got home, she sat on the bed reading and drinking hot tea.
On Wednesday the rain was terribly heavy! My brother couldn't go out to play ball, so he went online in his room.

zh: 星期二，还是下雨。天冷了。妈妈回家后，坐在床上看书，喝热茶。星期三，雨太大了！哥哥不能出去打球，他在房间里上网。

segs.en: On Thursday I wrote characters at home, and Grandma sang beside me.
And on Friday, what about my sister? She was asleep.
While it rained outside, she just stayed in bed and slept. From Monday to Friday she was happy every single day.

zh: 星期四，我在家写汉字，奶奶在我旁边唱歌。星期五，妹妹呢？她在睡觉。外边下雨，她就在床上睡觉。星期一到星期五，她天天都很高兴。

segs.en: Saturday
On Saturday morning I got up. It was still raining outside.
“Still raining!” said my brother. “I want to go out and play ball!”
“I want to go for a walk in the hills,” said Dad.
“I want to go to the shopping centre and buy some clothes,” said Mum.
“I want to go and see a film,” I said.

zh: 星期六早上，我起床了。外边还是下雨。哥哥说：“还是下雨！我想出去打球！”爸爸说：“我想去山上走走。”妈妈说：“我想去商场买衣服。”我说：“我想去看电影。”

segs.en: My sister said, “I like rain! When it rains, I can stay at home and sleep.”
All of us were grumpy. She was the only happy one.
That evening Dad looked at his phone and said, “It's not going to rain tomorrow!”
“Brilliant!” we all said.

zh: 妹妹说：“我喜欢下雨！下雨的时候，我能在家睡觉。”我们都不高兴，她一个人很高兴。晚上，爸爸看了看手机，说：“明天不下雨了！”我们都说：“太好了！”

segs.en: Sunday
On Sunday morning the rain had stopped! The weather was beautiful.
Dad, Mum, my brother and I were all up. And my sister? She was still asleep.
Mum called her: “Time to get up! We're going out today!”
“I'm not going,” said my sister. “I want to sleep.”
Grandma said, “Off you go. I'll stay at home with her.”

zh: 星期天早上，不下雨了！天气非常好。爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我都起床了。妹妹呢？她还在睡觉。妈妈叫她：“起床了！今天我们出去玩儿！”妹妹说：“我不去，我想睡觉。”奶奶说：“你们去吧，我和她在家。”

segs.en: We went up into the hills. The flowers there had come out, and they were lovely.
My brother played ball, Mum looked at the flowers, and Dad and I walked a long way.
At noon we had lunch up in the hills.
We spent the whole day out. We were so tired, and so happy!

zh: 我们去了山上。山上的花开了，很好看。哥哥打球，妈妈看花，爸爸和我走了很多路。中午，我们在山上吃了饭。我们玩儿了一天，太累了，也太高兴了！

segs.en: In the evening we got home. My sister had got up, and she asked, “Did it rain today?”
“No!” said my brother. “The weather was amazing today, and you slept the whole day!”
Just then, it started to rain outside.

zh: 晚上，我们回到家。妹妹起床了，她问：“今天下雨了吗？”哥哥说：“没有！今天天气非常好，你睡了一天！”这个时候，外边下雨了。

segs.en: My sister beamed. “It's raining! Great!”
She climbed back into bed and said, “See you tomorrow!”
We all looked at her and laughed.
In our family, the person who likes rain best is my little sister.

zh: 妹妹笑了：“下雨了！太好了！”她回到床上，说：“明天见！”我们看着她，都笑了。在我们家，最喜欢下雨的人，是妹妹。
